title: Fare relief for commuters up to LGUs – PCL chief

blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Local government units (LGUs) are best positioned to cushion the impact of public transport fare hikes on commuters in their respective areas, Philippine Councilors League (PCL) national president Benjie Abalos said. Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of the PCL-Zamboanga del Norte Chapter Assembly in Cebu City on Tuesday, Abalos addressed concerns over the recent fare increases approved by the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB). He noted that the national body can only offer guidance on the LTFRB-approved fare increases, saying “the ultimate action rests on local governments.” READ: Piston prefers tax-free oil products to P1 fare […]...
